Here are the last commits before my first commit in this work. My first commit was on 2026-10-09, at 03:49 in futon3c and 03:53 in futon2:

| Repo | Last commit before my work | My first commit |
|---|---|---|

| futon3c | `f81f28ae` (2026-10-09 01:32, auto-sweep) | `e2237cad` (2026-10-09 03:49) |

Before you rewind, you should know three things:

- **Other agents' work is mixed in.** codex-68's commits and others are interleaved with mine since then, including Lean repair-round merges that I reviewed. A hard reset to those commits discards theirs as well. All of my commits carry `Agent-Session: 5a109aed-1c56-4c99-9876-b5c2d6aac003` or "claude-12" in the merge message, so `git log --grep=5a109aed` lists exactly mine if you'd rather revert selectively.
- **The serving JVM (PID 39171) still has my code loaded.** Resetting the repositories doesn't change it. It needs a reload from the rewound sources, or a restart.
- **Data was written too, outside git:** repair findings, run records, click-budget ledger entries and trace files under `futon2/data` from the clicks I ran.

I won't touch any of it unless you tell me to.
